✨ Sheep Tracker v9
New dashboard, QR sync & more — here's what's new
🏠 New home dashboard
Alerts for flagged sheep, withholding, weight loss and overdue weighs — all on the first screen. Mob tiles show when each mob is due for weighing.
📲 QR code sync
Generate a QR code — the other person scans it and new records merge automatically. No files, no internet needed. Find it in Home → Sync strip or Settings → Share & Sync.
⚖️ Per-mob weigh schedule
Set how often each mob should be weighed — the dashboard shows due/overdue badges per mob. Set it when creating or editing a mob.
📉 Weight loss drill-through
Tap the weight loss alert on the dashboard to go straight to the affected sheep in Flock — no searching needed.
➕ New recording menu & cleaner design
The + button opens a quick-action sheet — faster to reach any record type. Haptic feedback on save. Easier to read in sunlight.

📋 Release log

v9 — April 2026
New home dashboard — alerts, mob tiles, sync strip
QR code sync — generate delta QR, scan to merge, AirDrop fallback
Per-mob weigh interval — due/overdue badges on dashboard and mob cards
Weight loss alert drills through to affected sheep in flock
FAB slide-up sheet replaces hub grid
Sex buttons only shown when sex is unknown
Auto-advance to weight field after tag entry
Haptic feedback on save
Breeding section placeholder (coming v10)
New theme — cleaner, better sunlight readability
v8 — 2025
Share & Sync via AirDrop/iMessage with smart merge
Flag reason field, bulk flag actions
Weight history editing and deletion
Delete whole sheep
Mob location history with Move Paddock
Drench withholding in CSV export
Self-hosted fonts (Nunito + Courier Prime)
v7 — 2025
IndexedDB storage — 12-month rolling archive
Mob weigh session with unweighed review
New sheep with sire tags
Notes life timeline
Unweighed sheep
Move selected to mob
